name: The Detective's Secret Archive
intro: You step into a dimly lit 1920s detective's office smelling of stale tobacco and old paper. Heavy velvet drapes block out the city lights, illuminating a mahogany desk, a brass compass, an iron safe, a framed parchment, a silver cipher wheel, an oak filing cabinet, and a coat rack. A sturdy oak door leads back out to the corridor.
escapeText: The heavy oak door clicks open, allowing you to slip out into the foggy alleyway before the mob catches up.

exit.name: oak door
exit.description: A thick oak door fitted with a heavy brass deadbolt. It is locked tight.

codeClue.name: brass compass
codeClue.description: A heavy nautical brass compass. Scratched delicately onto the underside of its lid is the date 5/9/24.

riddle.name: framed parchment
riddle.description: A yellowed document in a wooden frame. It reads: 'True north points not to stars, but to the day the case was solved. Find the needle's home.'

furniture.name: mahogany desk
furniture.description: A cluttered mahogany desk scattered with empty coffee cups, inkwells, and blank case reports.

lockbox.name: iron safe
lockbox.description: A sturdy floor safe crafted from cast iron. A 4-digit combination dial protects its contents.

revealSurface.name: oak filing cabinet
revealSurface.description: A tall filing cabinet filled with folder tabs. Something faint seems smudged across the main drawer front, visible only under polarized light.

passwordLock.name: silver cipher wheel
passwordLock.description: A desk cipher device with alphabetical rotors. A small brass plaque beside it reads: 'Examine the files through ruby glass to find the master word.'

compartment.name: secret drawer
compartment.description: A small compartment under the cipher wheel that pops open when the correct word is aligned.

decoy.name: coat rack
decoy.description: A tall brass coat rack holding a damp trench coat.

tool.name: red monocle
tool.description: A single magnifying lens set in brass with tinted red glass.

exitKey.name: skeleton key
exitKey.description: An ornate brass skeleton key stamped with the room number.

decoyItem.name: fedora hat
decoyItem.description: A stylish felt hat with a silk band. It has no practical use.

lockbox: Read the framed parchment to figure out where the numbers are written.
The riddle points to the compass. Check its description for four digits to open the iron safe.
reveal: Look inside the iron safe once unlocked to find a useful optic tool.
Use the red monocle on the oak filing cabinet to reveal what is hidden there.
passwordLock: The hidden writing on the filing cabinet holds the password.
Enter the uppercase word found on the filing cabinet into the silver cipher wheel.
exitKey: Unlocking the cipher wheel opened a hidden space.
Look inside the secret drawer to get the key.
exit: You have the key to leave.
Use the skeleton key on the oak door to escape.
